notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL 1.1 Update Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]A few months ago I decided to take a break from my new project, [i]Morpho (working title)[/i], to return to [i]SENTIENT STEEL[/i] with fresh eyes, over a year after release. [/p][p]As a [b]thank you[/b] to those who have played, and as a personal bookend on this project, I wanted to publish a comprehensive free update to address the shortcomings that I ran out of time to fix last year.[/p][p]Over time, the scope of the update expanded, until I had eventually looked at [b]almost every element of the game[/b]. Here's a list of the key improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Significantly improved performance[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay improvements and rebalancing[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled visuals and interfaces[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio[/p][/*][*][p]120fps support[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]So, whether you're back to fight the infection all over again, or returning to finish it off, I hope you enjoy the updates in[i] 1.1[/i]![/p][p]Lastly, if you're new to [i]SENTIENT STEEL[/i], please consider trying the [b]free demo[/b]! It has been updated to [b]Ver. 3[/b], which includes all the improvements present in the main game.[/p][p]Thank you for all of your kind support.[/p][p]- etcher[/p]
